services.value: Teklab provides environmental analytical testing services including drinking water bacteria (total and fecal coliform), PFAS testing, PCB testing (e.g., indoor air and schools), hazardous waste testing, VOA/VOC testing, organic and inorganic testing, and metals testing using ICP/ICP-MS. The site also lists pharmaceutical effluent testing methods (EPA 1666 and EPA 524.2 PMI) and multiple air and soil testing capabilities.
